workflowInput.requestedWork: Validate the best prompt learned in train-0002 on fresh image generations, preserving its identity and style improvements while using the corrected provenance review contract.
acceptanceCriteria: The selected image preserves the person reference identity.
The selected image matches the style reference without copying its person's identity.
The judge calibration relations pass before candidate scoring.
Every generated image hash is verified against generation.output.sha256.
The judge loss is at or below 0.08, or the workflow exits honestly at the configured maximum round.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths in persisted artifacts.
Use the built-in image generation tool, not an API or CLI fallback.
Preserve all candidates and raw judge evidence.
Do not alter truth or input images.
Do not modify failed train-0001 or train-0002 evidence.
